areas.fix_scope: One commit per words file or screen (or per sentence and the test that reads it), each wording asserted at its boundary: a unit test of the function that writes it, a real-daemon case in polish-words' own describe block of apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts for every text a route serves (GET /projects and /projects/:id status lines, /projects/:id/tasks and /tasks/:id display, /sessions/:id statusText, /inbox card words, /projects/:id/costs, /projects/:id/reviews), the fake daemon (apps/ui/test/fake-daemon.ts, fake-tasks.ts) changed in the same commit where a route's shape or a mirrored text changes (C-21's sign-off kind, P7-6's base field), and a screen check in a new apps/ui/test/polish-words.test.tsx (the Tasks row and drawer, New task's review choice, the Inbox plan card, the session page's pull request line). An existing assertion (unit, UI, real-daemon, e2e) of a text this area changes is updated in the same commit, that assertion only (e.g. real-daemon.test.ts:1280 'Your files:', :3391/:4858 'Needs your decision', :3700 'starts working on them now'; tasks.test.tsx 'nothing runs in isolation', 'coder limit', 'out of main'; home.test.tsx, plain-words.test.tsx and e2e/smoke.spec.ts 'Waiting for you: 2 questions'; session.test.tsx 'branch fr/'). Design §5 rules: one sentence a person reads at a glance (status ≤ 80 characters, consequence ≤ 100, card body ≤ 2 sentences, result ≤ 3 lines, notification title ≤ 60 and body ≤ 140), what needs you first, names not ids (no task-id branch prefix, no rule ids, no source names such as web_page), true when read (L-21, P7-7), no '(s)' plurals, no tier, ladder or verdict words, no JSON or markdown, CHF only with two decimals ('less than CHF 0.01' below a centime), errors say what went wrong and what to do (R-2, P7-24, P7-27). Rewords on top of wave 12's logic: in the shared files shared_files names the functions polish-words may change; no logic change beyond what an item names (C-55's ensureBaseBranch, C-21's sign-off kind and its Answer/Cancel row, L-21's read-time count, P7-20's work-in-progress check, P7-21's per-task explain, L-20's busy line, R-2's order of tests, P7-14's once-per-plan line, P7-6's base branch field). C-39's line is its own builder appended to result.ts's ordered list (at most three lines stay). writing-rules.test.ts (system-text's, 4a8ec47) extended to every new or changed text. Docs in the same commits: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] (one line per person-visible change; R-2's example made true; P7-2), docs/maintainers/runtime.md (P7-13 and the sections of the files it changes), capabilities.md, critic.md, notifications.md, data.md (C-55), apps.md (#40's summary row and the Tasks and Inbox rows it changes), validation.md (P7-3), user-guide.md (P7-29 and the Tasks and Inbox paragraphs it changes); U-074's row in UPDATE-LOG.md. Settings' rows and change sentences (P7-10, P7-28, P7-31, later #30/#43) are polish-screens'. Items moved out earlier stay out: C-30, C-37 ('budget-resume'), C-53 ('merged-copy'), C-56 ('merge-in-app'), C-60 ('merged-actions'), C-70, C-71 ('sites'); the BillingOrderSection.tsx words ('credential-chooser'); Q7 ('polish-desktop'). Design §5: one sentence a person reads at a glance, no raw statuses in parentheses, 24-hour HH:MM everywhere on a screen, CHF only, no ids, no JSON; one button per action (one start button; one action per Home row, the card's own; the palette's Stop all asks once and is listed only while something runs, its other state 'Allow sessions again'). Design §6: a project's and a task's budget accept 0 and read 'no budget' ('0 means no cap' where it is true); the monthly cap stays positive and says why, unless the owner decides otherwise (owner_questions; record the answer in U-074). The daemon's other sentences are polish-words'; this area owns the Settings words in packages/commands (budget.ts, settings.ts), settings-view.ts and webAccessWords, and in compose.ts only the first human's insert. SetupPage picks the first step not done (a refused or missing key opens the Claude step), so the '/setup' links stay. Docs in the same commits: the route rows of the screens it changes in docs/maintainers/apps.md, commands.md (budget.set, settings.set's displays), the runtime.md sections of settings-view.ts, the first human's cap and webAccessWords, the user-guide paragraphs about those screens, its own CHANGELOG [Unreleased] lines (appended), U-077 and its U-074 bullet in UPDATE-LOG.md (U-047 and U-030 come from phaseE's polish u_entries with no item here: add a note only if an item changes what they describe). The items assigned to polish-words are not done here (the Tasks screen, the Inbox plan card, the session page's pull request line).
